result.question: How has Nvidia's net income evolved over its last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Nvidia's net income has grown dramatically over its last three fiscal years, more than quadrupling from FY 2024 to FY 2026. In fiscal year 2024 (period ending January 28, 2024), net income was $29.76 billion [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2024-01-28]. In fiscal year 2025 (period ending January 26, 2025), net income rose to $72.88 billion [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-01-26], an increase of approximately 145% year-over-year. In fiscal year 2026 (period ending January 25, 2026), net income reached $120.07 billion [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25], representing a further increase of approximately 65% over FY 2025. All three figures were reported in Nvidia's 10-K filing (0001045810-26-000021).
